name: devguard
description: Tooling only: release-kit (versions, changelog, tags, commit checks) for devguard, which is Python and publishes as agent-devguard.

scripts.lint: uvx ruff@0.17.3 check src tests && uvx ruff@0.17.3 format --check src tests
scripts.test: cd tests && python3 -W error::ResourceWarning -m unittest discover -s .
scripts.release:check: release-kit check && npm run lint && npm test
